name: Sleep Therapy Workshop
description: A guided session on healthy sleep hygiene and recovery techniques to help students rest and recharge.

name: 5K Marathon
description: A community run around campus promoting physical activity as a pillar of mental wellbeing.

name: Wellness Workshop
description: An interactive session introducing practical tools and habits for everyday emotional wellbeing.

name: Blindfold Conversations
description: A trust-building activity that uses blindfolded pair conversations to encourage open, judgement-free listening.

name: Hostel Drive
description: Hostel-level outreach connecting residents with MITR coordinators and campus wellness resources.

name: Anger Management Workshop
description: A guided workshop on recognising anger triggers and building healthier coping responses.

name: Candle Making Workshop
description: A relaxed, hands-on creative session using candle making as a form of mindful self-care.

name: DJ Night
description: A campus-wide music night giving students a fun, low-pressure way to unwind together.

name: Games Night
description: An evening of casual games designed to bring students together and build community bonds.

name: Breaking the Silence: Understanding and Preventing Youth Suicide
description: An awareness session on youth suicide prevention, warning signs, and how to support a peer in crisis.

name: Jar Painting Workshop
description: A creative art therapy session where students paint and personalise jars as a form of mindful expression.

name: Dance Therapy
description: A movement-based therapy session using dance to help students release stress and reconnect with their bodies.

name: Game Stalls, Food Stalls & Photobooth
description: A festive lineup of game stalls, food stalls, and a photobooth bringing the campus together for a fun day out.

name: DOST-ROPE Stalls
description: Information stalls run in collaboration with DOST-ROPE to raise awareness of available support services.

name: MITR Stalls during UG and PG Admissions
description: Welcome stalls set up during UG and PG admissions to introduce incoming students to MITR and its support network.

name: Wellness Brochure
description: A printed and digital brochure outlining campus wellness resources, contacts, and self-care tips.

name: Wellness Assessment Test
description: A self-reflection questionnaire that helps students check in on their own mental wellbeing.

name: Sphere Immersion Program
description: An immersive program designed to build empathy and connection among student peer coordinators.

name: IE Orientation for Freshers
description: An orientation session introducing incoming freshers to campus life and the support systems available to them.

name: Mentifusion
description: A collaborative mentorship program connecting students across years to foster guidance and community.
